title: Home Oxygen Therapy: Age of the New Coverage's Last Eligibility Check
content:
# Age of the New Coverage's Last Eligibility Check — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Rule.** When a different coverage becomes primary for Home Oxygen Therapy, the first day of service found from the claim history replaces the effective date only when the new coverage's last eligibility check is no more than the figure below before the confirmation. The class and the last eligibility check date are those of the new coverage in the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the first day of service is the effective date.

| Class of the new coverage | Last eligibility check no more than (days before the confirmation) |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B, Medicare Supplement Plan G | 90 |
| Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO, Medicare Advantage PPO, Medicare Advantage HMO | 30 |
| any other class | 0 (the check is dated on the day of the confirmation) |

## Both sides (hypothetical, confirmation on 10 June)

| New coverage class | Last eligibility check | Days before | Condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 12 March | 90 | met |
| Original Medicare Part B | 11 March | 91 | fails |
| Commercial PPO | 11 May | 30 | met |
| Commercial PPO | 10 May | 31 | fails |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 10 June | 0 | met |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 9 June | 1 | fails |
